# 皇帝报告者作用域；CHARACTER为输出人物scope，KIND=1奉祠／2致仕。
# 自建家门与成年子嗣，在人物变量保存家门、庄园和继承人，并加入本例局部列表。
tca_test_create_retirement_native_family_effect = {
    tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_with_age_effect = { CHARACTER = $CHARACTER$ GOVERNMENT = celestial_government AGE = 80 }
    scope:$CHARACTER$ = {
        add_to_list = tca_nb_actors
        change_influence = 1000
        set_focus = diplomacy_family_focus
        set_variable = { name = tca_nb_family value = primary_title }
        set_variable = { name = tca_nb_estate value = domicile }
        create_character = { age = 18 gender_female_chance = 0 random_traits = no dynasty = this.dynasty father = this employer = this culture = this.culture faith = this.faith rite = this.rite save_scope_as = tca_nb_child }
        set_variable = { name = tca_nb_heir value = scope:tca_nb_child }
        scope:tca_nb_child = { set_house = prev.house tca_test_protect_character_effect = yes add_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert set_appointment_timeout = { years = 150 desc = appointment_timeout_desc_refusing } }
        tca_retirement_enter_effect = { KIND = $KIND$ }
        tca_retirement_step_down_effect = yes
        add_character_flag = { flag = tca_retirement_request_denied days = 365 }
    }
}
